root.name: Scotch Game: Paulsen Attack
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nxd4 Bc5 5. Be3 Qf6 6. c3 Nge7 7. Bb5

overview: In the Scotch Classical with 4...Bc5 5.Be3 Qf6 6.c3 Nge7 White plays 7.Bb5, pinning Nc6 and hitting d4 with tempo. Black's early queen on f6 and the knight on e7 are ready to castle; White has a lead in space and an active knight on d4. Both sides develop rapidly in an open centre.

white_ideas.idea: Use Bb5 and O-O with the central knight on d4
Break with Nb3 or f4/c4 depending on Black's moves

black_ideas.idea: Castle and play ...Nxd4 to trade pieces
Use the queen on f6 for pressure on d4

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with pawn on e4 vs missing e5
White knight on d4 vs Black Bc5/Qf6

character.reason: Open Scotch lines with chances for both.
